title: The Apple That Went Traveling
synopsis: An especially round apple takes a rolling trip through the orchard and turns into a shared joke and a new mark on the map.
continuity_state: Before: Kim lives across bridge and knows Amy/Ben. After: supervised visit to orchard, old mill mapped, apple recovered, washed, sliced, drawn as a red dot with leaf.
